title: Upper threshold parameter
statement: Let $\epsilon$ satisfy $0<\epsilon<\tfrac12$, and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube. Its upper threshold parameter is the biased probability level of $f$ at $1-\epsilon$.
caveat: The underlying biased probability level is defined using a polynomial whose definition is not supplied.
